findings.text: The Today page shows none of the owner's prompts ("all the prompts from today should go into that card"). In my own headless shot of /framework/ai/2026-10-04/ at 1200, it reads "No prompts logged for this day yet." Two reasons in `day-prompts.js`. First, `readPrompt()` keeps only the LAST Prompt in a session: `session-60d9def6` (in the 2026/10/03 folder) holds 66 owner prompts, so 65 are dropped. Second, `sessionsFor(date)` walks only the folder of the day the session started, but all 66 of those prompts are stamped 2026-10-04, so they show on neither day. The day should be read by each prompt's own `ts`, every Prompt in a session should be kept, and the search should cover the session folders of the day before as well.

Deliverable 3, "a confidence 0–1 per sentence → section in `structure()`", was not built. The diff never touches `ext/Refine/structure.js`. The "Check these" block lists `clean()`'s mishearing flags instead, which measure something different: how sure the model is that it heard a word right, not how sure it is that the sentence belongs in its section.

The dates break west of UTC. The Today card's corner says "Oct 3" above "Sunday, Oct 4", and Yesterday's says "Oct 2" above "Saturday, Oct 3" (shots/…-framework-ai/1920.png, pinned rows): the `at: "2026-10-04"` value is read as UTC midnight. `monthPage()` has the same bug, from `new Date(month + "-01")` and `new Date(d).getMonth()`: /framework/ai/2026-10/ would be titled "September 2026" and skip the 1st of the month. `todayStr()` uses the UTC date while the rail uses the local date, so after 7 pm Central the "next day" arrow links to tomorrow.

The prompts header wraps badly at 1200 (my headless shot). "Your prompts, refined" breaks onto 2 lines, "by time" and "by system" each break onto 2 lines, and "condense" is a large gray button. A stray "0" sits under "Proposed — 8 not started".

Deliverable 2 asks for the day's cost, but at 1200 the page shows "Spend not computed yet — run node Server/day-spend.mjs 2026-10-04." The day summary reads cost but never produces it, so Today's card has no cost until someone runs that script.

None of the given shots shows a page this diff builds: the day page, by-system or the month stub. They show /framework/ai/, the 2026 and 2026/09 folder pages, 2026/10/02, and five unrelated ai2 cards whose only change is `"gone"` file lines. The diff also carries about 1,600 `"gone"` lines in `2026/10/02/page.jsonl` and churn in many `files.jsonl` files that this task did not ask for.
`ext/AITask/dashboard.js` now imports `mark_read` from `/framework/ai2/rules.js`, which means a module under `ext/` imports from a page folder. That goes against "imports flow down".

An orphan doc comment ("A day's own tasks…") now sits above `addDays`, and the same comment repeats above `dashboard()`. The by-system docblock sits directly above `monthPage`'s docblock, so each one reads as if it described the other function.

answer.reply: fixed: readPrompts() now keeps every Prompt item in a session (was keeping only the last); dayPrompts() also searches the PRIOR day's folder and filters by each item's own ts, since a long session can log a prompt a day after its folder's own date.

fixed: structure.js now returns confidence per sentence->section (1 placed once, 0.4 duplicated, 0.2 dropped), carried through day-prompts-refine.mjs's and Echo.js's own coverage object; checkThese() reads it directly and still shows clean()'s separate wording-confidence flags alongside, labelled apart.

fixed: rail.js's pinned Today/Yesterday now carry a full ISO instant in `at` (was a bare YYYY-MM-DD, parsed as UTC midnight); dashboard.js's todayStr() now reads local date components instead of the UTC ISO slice; monthPage() now uses the local 3-arg Date(y, m-1, 1) constructor instead of parsing a date string.
